```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE)
```

The [GWAS fine-mapping example](Finemapping_bayesian_linear_regression_real_data.html)
shows the complete workflow: `getLDscores(Glist, chr="17")`,
`createLDsets(ldscores=ldscores)` and `gmap(Glist=Glist, stat=stat, sets=sets, method="bayesC")`.

These marker sets are candidate regions. Use separately verified independent
blocks when fitting a genome-wide block-eigen model.
